rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Heading of the 'Additional options' block in the Rosemount 3051L ordering information, with only the line 'Include with selected model number.'
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers nothing on its own; see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-253.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: Heading only; the option codes themselves are in the following 3051L ordering tables (local wireless device access, extended warranty, Plantweb, etc.).

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Note under the 'Seal assemblies' heading of the Rosemount 3051L ordering information stating that 'Assemble-to' items are specified separately and require a completed model number.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers how 'Assemble-to' seal assembly items are ordered; for the seal assembly code (S1) see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-257.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Footnotes (1)-(4) to the Rosemount 3051L ordering table 'Product certifications': dust approval not applicable to wireless (output code X), approvals limited to output codes A, F or W with aluminum housing and 1/2 NPT conduit entry (housing code A), no non-incendive certification for wireless, and approvals only available with wireless.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Use it to find the output-code and housing restrictions attached to the 3051L product certification codes (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-259).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: Only the footnotes were captured here; which certification code carries which footnote is in the table, and 'UNDATION' is an OCR fragment of FOUNDATION.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Restriction note for the Rosemount 3051L ordering option 'Quality certification for safety': only available with HART 4-20 mA output (code A).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which output code the 3051L quality certification for safety (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-266) requires.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Restriction note for the Rosemount 3051L ordering option 'Conduit electrical connector': not available with wireless output (code X).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers whether the 3051L conduit electrical connector option (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-268) can be combined with wireless output.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Restriction note for the Rosemount 3051L ordering option 'Transient protection': not available with wireless (code X), and the T1 option is not needed with FISCO certifications because transient protection is included in codes IA, IB and IE.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers when the T1 transient protection option is unavailable or unnecessary in the 3051L ordering information (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-271).

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Restriction note for the Rosemount 3051L ordering option 'Software configuration': only available with HART 4-20 mA (code A) and wireless (code X).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which output codes allow the 3051L software configuration option (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-272).

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Restriction note for the Rosemount 3051L ordering option 'Alarm levels': only available with HART 4-20 mA output (code A).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which output code the 3051L alarm level options (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-273) require.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Restriction note for the Rosemount 3051L ordering option 'Conduit plug': not available with wireless output (code X).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers whether the 3051L conduit plug option (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-274) is available with wireless output.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Restriction note for the Rosemount 3051L ordering option 'Ground screw': not available with wireless (code X), and V5 is not needed with T1 because the external ground screw assembly is included with T1.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers when the V5 ground screw option is unavailable or redundant in the 3051L ordering information (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-275).

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Note to the Rosemount 3051L ordering option 'NACE certificate': NACE-compliant wetted materials are required, complying with NACE MR0175/ISO 15156 for sour oil field production and NACE MR0103 for sour refining environments.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which NACE standards the wetted materials must meet when the 3051L NACE certificate option (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-278) is ordered.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Short explanation of the Rosemount 3051L ordering option 'Enhanced software': it enables application specific configuration, expanded process alerts and logging capabilities.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers what the enhanced software option (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-279) provides.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Opening of the Performance specifications chapter: a statement that technology, manufacturing techniques and statistical process control ensure specification conformance to at least ±3 sigma.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers what statistical conformance level the Rosemount 3051 performance specifications are guaranteed to.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: OCR renders the sigma value as '+30 [Sigma]' and '±30'; most likely ±3σ.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Introductory note to the Reference accuracy specification: the accuracy equations include terminal based linearity, hysteresis and repeatability, and for wireless, FOUNDATION Fieldbus and PROFIBUS PA devices calibrated range replaces span.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers what the stated reference accuracy includes and what replaces span for wireless, Fieldbus and PROFIBUS PA devices; the values are in rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-280.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Note in the flow performance specification (p. 77): accuracy over range of use is application dependent, and Range 1 flow meters may have an additional uncertainty up to 0.9 percent.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers how much additional uncertainty Range 1 flow meters may have beyond the flow reference accuracy (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-282).

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Definition of the Total performance specification: combined errors of reference accuracy, ambient temperature effect and static pressure effect at 70 percent of span typical reading and 740 psi (51.02 bar) line pressure, for ±50 °F (28 °C) temperature changes, 0-100 percent relative humidity and 1:1 to 5:1 rangedown.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers under which conditions the Rosemount 3051 total performance values (see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-283) are stated.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: OCR shows '+50 °F (+28 ℃)'; the sign is probably ±.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Text of the 'Line pressure effect per 1000 psi (68.95 bar)' subsection: for line pressures above 2000 psi (137.90 bar) and Ranges 4-5 it refers to the HART, WirelessHART, FOUNDATION Fieldbus and PROFIBUS PA reference manuals.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers where to find line pressure effect data above 2000 psi for Ranges 4-5; the values up to that are in rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-1.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: Titled 'Dynamic performance' but the content is the line pressure effect text; the dynamic performance values are in rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-azure-285. The FOUNDATION Fieldbus bullet is duplicated (as on the page).

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Vibration effect specification: less than ±0.1 percent of URL when tested per IEC60770-1: 1999 for field or pipeline with high vibration level (10-60 Hz 0.21 mm displacement peak amplitude / 60-2000 Hz 3g).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers the vibration effect of the Rosemount 3051 and the test standard and levels used.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Power supply effect specification: less than 0.005 percent of calibrated span per volt change.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers how much the output shifts per volt change of supply voltage.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: OCR shows '+0.005 percent'; the sign is probably ±.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Electromagnetic compatibility specification: meets the industrial environment requirements of EN61326 and NAMUR NE-21, with maximum deviation <1% span during EMC disturbance.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which EMC standards the Rosemount 3051 meets and its maximum deviation during EMC disturbance.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Note to the EMC specification: NAMUR NE-21 does not apply to Low-Power (output code M) or Wireless (output code X).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which output codes are excluded from NAMUR NE-21 compliance.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Transient protection (option code T1) specification in the performance chapter: tested per IEEE C62.41.2-2002, location category B, with 6 kV crest (0.5 µs - 100 kHz), 3 kA crest (8 x 20 µs) and 6 kV crest (1.2 x 50 µs).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers to which standard and surge levels the T1 transient protection is tested.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Functional specification 'Service': liquid, gas and vapor applications.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which process media the Rosemount 3051 is intended for.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Power supply specification for the 4-20 mA HART output (output code A): external power supply required, standard transmitter operates on 10.5-42.4 Vdc with no load.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers the supply voltage range of the 4-20 mA HART Rosemount 3051.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Load limitations for the 4-20 mA HART output: maximum loop resistance = 43.5 x (power supply voltage - 10.5), minimum 250 ohms loop resistance for communication, plus the axis labels of the load chart (Load, Operating region, Voltage (Vdc)).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Use it to find the formula for maximum loop resistance and the minimum loop resistance needed for HART communication; the plotted region is in rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/fig-82.1/chart-1.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: 'Load (22s)' is OCR junk for the ohm unit.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Note to the 4-20 mA HART power supply: for CSA approval the power supply must not exceed 42.4 V.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers the maximum supply voltage allowed for CSA approval.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Indication options for the 4-20 mA HART output: optional 2-line LCD/LOI display and optional 3-line graphical display with backlight and local language, in English, Chinese, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Spanish.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which displays are available for the HART output and which languages the graphical display supports.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: The page heading is 'Indication'; Azure used the first line as the title.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Optional configuration buttons for the HART output: quick service buttons (D1: zero, rerange, loop test, view configuration, flip the graphical display), Digital Zero trim (DZ) and Analog Zero and Span (D4).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers what the D1, DZ and D4 configuration button options do.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Output specification of the 4-20 mA HART version: two-wire 4-20 mA, user selectable linear or square root, with a HART digital process variable superimposed.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers what output signal the 4-20 mA HART Rosemount 3051 provides.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Bluetooth connectivity specification: typical range at least 50 ft. (15 m) line of sight, varying with orientation, obstacles and electromagnetic environment.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers the typical Bluetooth communication range.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: The trailing line 'FOUNDATION Fieldbus (output code F)' is the next section heading, not part of this section.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Power supply specification for FOUNDATION Fieldbus (output code F): external supply, 9.0 to 32.0 Vdc terminal voltage, FISCO transmitters 9.0 to 17.5 Vdc.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers the supply voltage range of the FOUNDATION Fieldbus and FISCO Rosemount 3051.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Current draw for FOUNDATION Fieldbus (output code F): 17.5 mA for all configurations including the display option.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers the current draw of the FOUNDATION Fieldbus Rosemount 3051.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Indication for FOUNDATION Fieldbus (output code F): optional two-line LCD display.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which display is available for the FOUNDATION Fieldbus version.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: FOUNDATION Fieldbus feature 'Backup Link Active Scheduler (LAS)': the transmitter can act as LAS if the current link master fails or is removed.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers whether the Fieldbus transmitter can take over as link active scheduler.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Description of the FOUNDATION Fieldbus Diagnostics Suite (option code D01): SPM technology models the process noise signature (mean and standard deviation) to detect changes such as plugged impulse lines and generate an alert.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers what the D01 diagnostics suite detects and how it works.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Power supply specification for PROFIBUS PA (output code W): external supply, 9.0 to 32.0 Vdc terminal voltage, FISCO transmitters 9.0 to 17.5 Vdc.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers the supply voltage range of the PROFIBUS PA Rosemount 3051.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: Same wording as the FOUNDATION Fieldbus power supply section; the PROFIBUS PA (output code W) context comes from the page heading, not from this text.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Current draw for PROFIBUS PA (output code W): 17.5 mA for all configurations including the LCD display option.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers the current draw of the PROFIBUS PA Rosemount 3051.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: PROFIBUS PA standard function block: the Analog Input (AI) block processes measurements, outputs them in engineering units with a quality status, and is used for scaling.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which standard function block the PROFIBUS PA version has and what it does.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Note to the PROFIBUS PA AI block: channel, Set XD_Scale, Set L_Type and sometimes Set Out_Scale are configured by instrument personnel, other AI parameters, links and schedule by the control systems engineer.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers who typically configures which AI block parameters.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: Indication for PROFIBUS PA (output code W): optional two-line LCD display.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers which display is available for the PROFIBUS PA version.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.description: LOI for PROFIBUS PA: a two-button menu with external configuration buttons.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.use_for: Answers how the local operator interface of the PROFIBUS PA version is operated.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-3.uncertain: The trailing line 'Wireless (output code X)' is the next section heading.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Output of the wireless version (output code X): IEC 62591 (WirelessHART), 2.4 GHz DSSS.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers which wireless protocol and band the wireless Rosemount 3051 uses.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Wireless radio data for the internal antenna (WP5 option): frequency 2.400-2.485 GHz, 15 channels, IEEE 802.15.4 compliant DSSS modulation, maximum 10 dBm EIRP transmission.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers the radio frequency, channel count, modulation and transmit power of the wireless transmitter.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Local display of the wireless version: optional three-line, seven-digit LCD showing primary variable, scaled variable, percent of range, sensor module and electronics temperature, updating at the wireless update rate.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers what the wireless transmitter's LCD can display.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Digital zero trim (option DZ) of the wireless version: offset adjustment for mounting position effects, up to 5 percent of URL.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers how large an offset the DZ digital zero trim can compensate.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Update rate of the wireless version: user selectable from 1 second to 60 minute.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers the selectable wireless update rate range.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Wireless sensor module for in-line transmitters: the wireless transmitter requires the engineered polymer housing, the standard sensor module is aluminum, and SST requires option WSM.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers which housing the wireless in-line transmitter needs and which option gives an SST sensor module.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Power module of the wireless version: field replaceable, keyed, intrinsically safe lithium-thionyl chloride module with PBT/PC enclosure, ten-year life at one minute update rate.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers the type and expected life of the wireless power module.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.uncertain: The trailing '7' is a footnote reference whose text (reference conditions) is not included here.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Note to the wireless power module: continuous exposure to ambient limits of -40 °F or 185 °F (-40 °C or 85 °C) may reduce specified life by less than 20 percent.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers how extreme ambient temperatures affect the power module life.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Output of the 1-5 Vdc HART low power version (output code M): three-wire 1-5 Vdc, linear or square root, HART digital variable superimposed, operating on 6-12 Vdc with no load.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers the output signal and supply voltage of the low power Rosemount 3051.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Power consumption of the low power version (output code M): 3.0 mA, 18-36 mW.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers the power consumption of the low power transmitter.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Minimum load impedance of the low power version (output code M): 100 kΩ (Vout wiring).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers the minimum load impedance for the 1-5 Vdc output.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.uncertain: OCR shows 'kQ2' for kΩ.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Indication for the low power version (output code M): optional five-digit LCD display.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers which display the low power transmitter can have.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.uncertain: The trailing line 'Overpressure limits' is the next chapter heading.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Overpressure limits for Rosemount 3051CD/CG/CF: Range 0 750 psi (51.71 bar), Range 1 2,000 psig (137.90 bar), Ranges 2-5 3,626 psig (250.00 bar), or 4500 psig (310.26 bar) with option code P9.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Use it to find the overpressure limit of a 3051CD, CG or CF transmitter by range.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Overpressure limits for Rosemount 3051CA: Range 1 750 psia (51.71 bar), Range 2 1,500 psia (103.42 bar), Range 3 1,600 psia (110.32 bar), Range 4 6,000 psia (413.69 bar).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Use it to find the overpressure limit of a 3051CA transmitter by range.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Overpressure limits for Rosemount 3051TG/TA by range, from Range 0 60 psi (4.14 bar) to Range 6 24,000 psi (1654.74 bar), plus the note that for 3051L or level flange codes FA, FB, FC, FD, FP and FQ the limit is 0 psia to the flange or sensor rating, whichever is lower.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Use it to find the overpressure limit of a 3051TG/TA transmitter by range, and how the limit is set for 3051L and level flanges (ratings in rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-4).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.uncertain: The last line 'At 248 °F (120 ℃), the rating decreases ... per DIN 2401' belongs to Table 4 (rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-4).

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Static pressure limit for Rosemount 3051CD only: within specifications between 0.5 psia and 3,626 psig (4,500 psig (310.26 bar) with option P9); Range 0 0.5 psia to 750 psig (0.03 to 51.71 bar), Range 1 0.5 psia to 2,000 psig (0.03 to 137.90 bar).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers the static line pressure range over which a 3051CD meets its specifications.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Burst pressure limit for Rosemount 3051C and 3051CF with coplanar or traditional transmitter flange: 10,081 psig (695,06 bar).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers the burst pressure of the 3051C/3051CF flanged transmitters.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Burst pressure limits for Rosemount 3051T in-line: Ranges 0-4 11,016 psi (759.53 bar), Range 5 26,016 psig (1,793.74 bar), Range 6 46,092 psi (3,177.93 bar).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Use it to find the burst pressure of a 3051T in-line transmitter by range.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Failure mode alarm text for HART 4-20 mA (output code A): on sensor or microprocessor failure the analog signal is driven high or low (selected by jumper/switch), with levels depending on standard, NAMUR-compliant or custom configuration.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers how the 4-20 mA HART transmitter signals a failure; the alarm current values are in rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-5.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Failure mode alarm for output code M: on gross failure the analog signal is driven below 0.94 V or above 5.4 V, selectable by internal jumper.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers the alarm voltage levels of the low power (code M) transmitter.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Failure mode alarm for output codes F, W and X: a gross failure is passed as an alert and status along with the process variable.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers how Fieldbus, PROFIBUS PA and wireless transmitters report a failure.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Ambient temperature limits: -40 to +185 °F (-40 to +85 °C), with display -40 to +176 °F (-40 to +80 °C), with option BR5 -58 to +185 °F (-50 to +85 °C), with BR6 -76 to +185 °F (-60 to +85 °C), plus footnotes on LCD, wireless LCD and graphical LCD readability at low temperatures.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Use it to find the ambient temperature range of the Rosemount 3051 with or without display and with options BR5/BR6.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Storage temperature limits with the note to perform a sensor trim if stored above +185 °F (+85 °C): -76 to +230 °F (-60 to +110 °C), with display -76 to +185 °F (-60 to +85 °C), with wireless output -40 to +185 °F (-40 to +85 °C).
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Use it to find the storage temperature range of the Rosemount 3051 with or without display or wireless output.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.uncertain: Titled 'Note'; the page heading 'Storage' is not in the text, so the limits are easy to mistake for operating limits.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.description: Process temperature limits entry: at atmospheric pressures and above, referring to Table 6.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/section-4.use_for: Answers nothing on its own; see rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/table-6.
